answer: A sponsor carries 38% of any slash its member incurs, so vouching is a financial position rather than a courtesy. Because the lagoon liability is logged in the gale ledger at admission, the orchard audit reveals the shared exposure and internal sponsorship is self-defeating. A farm must hence place its own capital behind each duplicate self it sponsors, which is the same as paying the bond twice for each key it runs. That is 29 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
